capabilities: Select source notes by folder or tag
Run LLM synthesis modes (thematic, methodological, gap analysis, draft section)
Generate output notes with frontmatter, backlinks, and timestamps
Format citations in APA, MLA, Chicago, or Harvard style
Connect to OpenAI, Anthropic, or OpenAI-compatible endpoints with your own API key
extras: Freemium: free tier allows 3 lifetime syntheses (stored locally per vault, may reset if plugin data is removed); Pro is a one-time purchase verified offline. Three of four synthesis modes are Pro-only. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Note content is sent to the configured LLM provider.
motivation: The author built it because for PhD students and researchers 'Taking notes is the easy part. Synthesizing them is the bottleneck.'
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to synthesize dozens of reading notes into a literature review; researchers must do the cross-source analysis manually.
